evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big bloom disc, medium leaves/stem, small gold centre dome.
evidence.V3: Stem is a straight uniform cylinder and petals are stiff flat slabs; leaves are nicely curved but overall only partly stylised.
evidence.V4: Petals have heavy hard chamfers that read gem-like, while leaves are razor-thin single blades with sharp knife edges and a dark crease where they meet the stem - inconsistent edge language.
evidence.V5: Close-up bloom shows stray faceting across petal tops and jagged zig-zag seams where petals overlap each other (visible in the flat close-up); 81 cross-shell overlaps; leaf root shows a dark sliver where blade meets stem.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one petal hue in 2-3 values, gold centre, leaf green secondary; colourways (bluebell, sunset) keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 520 tris vs small target 600 (ceiling 1500) - at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material and kit gold centre match, but petals are separate faceted slabs rather than fused smooth organic shells as wave-2 Nature asks.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for foliage: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, MeshPart white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Stray faceting on petal top surfaces
